command:
set -euo pipefail
view=$1; output_root=$2; evidence=$3; upper=$4; work=$5; ninja=$6
shift 6
babel_deps=("$@")
mount --make-rprivate /
mount --bind "$view" "$view"
mount -o remount,ro,bind "$view"
mount --bind "$evidence" "$evidence"
mount -o remount,rw,bind "$evidence"
mkdir -p /src
mount --bind "$view" /src
mount -o remount,ro,bind /src
mount --bind "${babel_deps[0]}" "${babel_deps[0]}"
mount -o remount,ro,bind "${babel_deps[0]}"
mount --bind "${babel_deps[0]}" "/src/developtools/ace_ets2bundle/compiler/node_modules"
mount -o remount,ro,bind "/src/developtools/ace_ets2bundle/compiler/node_modules"
mount --bind "${babel_deps[1]}" "${babel_deps[1]}"
mount -o remount,ro,bind "${babel_deps[1]}"
mount --bind "${babel_deps[1]}" "/src/developtools/ace_js2bundle/ace-loader/node_modules"
mount -o remount,ro,bind "/src/developtools/ace_js2bundle/ace-loader/node_modules"
mount --bind "${babel_deps[2]}" "${babel_deps[2]}"
mount -o remount,ro,bind "${babel_deps[2]}"
mount --bind "${babel_deps[2]}" "/src/third_party/parse5/packages/parse5/node_modules"
mount -o remount,ro,bind "/src/third_party/parse5/packages/parse5/node_modules"
mount --bind "${babel_deps[3]}" "${babel_deps[3]}"
mount -o remount,ro,bind "${babel_deps[3]}"
mount --bind "${babel_deps[3]}" "/src/third_party/weex-loader/node_modules"
mount -o remount,ro,bind "/src/third_party/weex-loader/node_modules"
mount -t overlay overlay -o "lowerdir=$output_root,upperdir=$upper,workdir=$work,index=off,metacopy=off" /src/out
mount -o remount,ro,bind /
{
  printf 'root_mount='; findmnt -n -T / -o OPTIONS
  printf 'source_view_mount='; findmnt -n -T /src/build -o TARGET,OPTIONS
  printf 'output_overlay_mount='; findmnt -n -T /src/out/rk3568 -o TARGET,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
printf 'npm_node_modules_0_mount='; findmnt -n -T "/src/developtools/ace_ets2bundle/compiler/node_modules" -o TARGET,OPTIONS
  printf 'npm_node_modules_1_mount='; findmnt -n -T "/src/developtools/ace_js2bundle/ace-loader/node_modules" -o TARGET,OPTIONS
  printf 'npm_node_modules_2_mount='; findmnt -n -T "/src/third_party/parse5/packages/parse5/node_modules" -o TARGET,OPTIONS
  printf 'npm_node_modules_3_mount='; findmnt -n -T "/src/third_party/weex-loader/node_modules" -o TARGET,OPTIONS
  printf 'network_namespace=%s\n' "$(readlink /proc/self/ns/net)"
  printf 'ninja_sha256=%s\n' "$(sha256sum "$ninja" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
} > "$evidence/execution_boundary.txt"
exec "$ninja" -C /src/out/rk3568 -w dupbuild=warn -k 0 -n
